   Help  General   Commands   Custom commands

   Claude understands your codebase, makes edits with
   your permission, and executes commands — right from
   your terminal.
   Shortcuts
   ! for shell     double tap esc to     ctrl + shift + _
   mode            clear input           to undo
   / for commands  shift + tab to        ctrl + z to
   @ for file      auto-accept edits     suspend
   paths           ctrl + x =/- to       ctrl + v to
   /btw for side   change effort         paste images
   question        ctrl + o for verbose  opt + p to
                   output                switch model
                   ctrl + t to toggle    opt + o to
                   tasks                 toggle fast mode
                   \⏎ for newline        ctrl + s to
                                         stash prompt
                                         ctrl + g to edit
                                         in $EDITOR
                                         /keybindings to
                                         customize

   For more help:
   https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview

   Esc to cancel
